about: What the phone's JavaScript lacks that Node and jest have. jest.setup.ts removes each entry; runtimeLacks.guard.test.ts fails on any use of one in app/ or src/; runtimeDump.contract.test.ts holds this list to the phone's own dump (e2e/runtime/phone-runtime.json). An api is Name.member (a static), Name.prototype.member, or globalThis.Name.
